answer: Open challenge market: anyone may challenge an identity with a 10 POA bond, and the identity must re-derive its last three answers from seed within two hours. Failure pays the challenger three times the bond from the identity's 200 POA stake and freezes it six epochs; a false challenge burns the challenger's bond. A hollow farm of 1,000 clones faces 1,000 challenges at an eight percent hit rate, burning 16,000 POA, while honest agents re-derive once and keep their harbor. Auditing pays, so the jetty of free entry is patrolled by strangers.
